name: nordvpn
description: The official NordVPN Linux client on distroless: no shell, rebuilt when upstream changes. Use it as a VPN network for other containers (Network Type: Container) with kill switch and allowlist set from env, or as a Meshnet node. Needs NET_ADMIN, NET_RAW and /dev/net/tun (set in Extra Parameters).

paths.name: State
paths.description: Login and Meshnet identity across restarts.

variables.name: Access token
variables.description: NordVPN account → Manual setup → Access token.

variables.name: Connect
variables.description: Country/city/server/group, anything `nordvpn connect` accepts. Empty = recommended server.

variables.name: Allowlist
variables.description: ; separated, each passed to `nordvpn allowlist add`. Replaces the allowlist each start.
